svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · synced · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard (App/PicPlaceStatusCard.swift, planned) — the PICPLACE section of a project's detail screen (iOS project-detail.*) and of the Mac Gallery item inspector: whether this project has a copy on the user's PicPlace account, and the one action that state offers. Six states, one file each: signed-out (no PicPlace account on this device), not-synced (never uploaded), changes (edited since the last sync), syncing (upload in flight — a progress bar in LL.amber on LL.controlFill, files and bytes done of total), synced (a copy is on the server: when, how much, and which OTHER devices report holding a copy — the server's presence records), failed (the last attempt's error in the caption; the write claim held by another device is the common one). The glyph column names the state: icloud (secondary outline) for signed-out and not-synced, icloud.and.arrow.up (accent) for changes and syncing, checkmark.icloud.fill (confirm green) for synced, exclamationmark.icloud.fill (system orange) for failed. Demo data: the 341-file, 4.9 MB photo project the server work was verified with, an iPad Air as the other device.
